Subject: Marketplace technical pairing — proposed deep-dive & calendar alignment

Hi Ethan / Priya —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for the time and the detailed walkthrough of BlueGrid’s marketplace onboarding goals. Quick recap and a suggested path forward so we can get to a technical deep-dive/demo that’s useful for both teams.

Recap (3 bullets):
- Primary objective: validate integration pattern for BlueGrid’s marketplace connector + confirm egress/security boundary for shared-hosted model.
- Key success criteria you called out: <1ms token latencies for search-ish flows is not required, but predictable 95th pct latency and cost per 1k tokens visibility.>
- Stakeholders: BlueGrid (Ethan, Priya), Redwood (Naomi, Jonas), potential SRE attendance from BlueGrid during the deep-dive for network questions.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive + short demo (60–75m): high-level architecture -> demo of integration -> Q&A on security/egress.
2) Follow-up: mutual action items & order-of-operations for marketplace onboarding.

I’ve proposed three candidate windows (all PDT):
- Tue Sep 7, 09:00–10:15
- Wed Sep 8, 13:00–14:15
- Thu Sep 9, 08:30–09:45

Please pick the one that works best (or suggest alternatives). Attendees we recommend from Redwood: Jonas Weber (solutions lead), Vanessa Ortiz (partner ops / calendar owner), and myself (product).

Attached: partner-tech-agenda.md (draft) — quick agenda and ownership notes.

If you want Redwood to own the calendar invite, say the word and I’ll loop Vanessa in to lock it.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
